In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover a two major stories shaping the Indian economy and global markets:
Story 1: Understanding REIT Results & Cash Flows
We will look into the latest results of India's biggest REITs and understand what really matters beyond profit numbers. The story explains how rental income turns into investor payouts, what drives REIT growth, the impact of debt and interest rates, and why the future of office demand could depend on AI.
Story 2: Can RBI Control Food Inflation?
